title: Postdoctoral Research Associate (Fixed Term)
institution: University of Cambridge, Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence
about: Two-year fixed-term postdoctoral post at the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence on a trustworthy AI project led by Professor Adrian Weller, spanning human-AI interaction, fairness, transparency, privacy and optimising deployed AI systems as human-machine teams.
requirements: PhD (or near completion) in computer science, information engineering, statistics, machine learning or a closely related field
Expertise in an area of trustworthy AI

upskill.name: Explainability, Interpretability & Trustworthy AI I
why: "Expertise in an area of trustworthy AI" (qualification) → "Fairness and bias detection: demographic parity, equalised odds, counterfactual fairness"

"fairness, transparency" (description) → "Explainable AI (XAI): LIME, SHAP, attention visualisation, saliency maps"; chosen over the higher-scoring general ML courses because it covers the project topic; it does not replace the required PhD
